remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946....No signature." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks note verso inscription. O'Keeffe wrote: "It has been snowing all day and I painted on the little Indian Snow man May I properly call him a 'Snow God'– I think there will be several paintings of him" (O'Keeffe to Maria Chabot, 10 December 1942). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Kokopelli with Snow

credit_line: Gift of The Burnett Foundation and The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Small light canvas with snow flakes falling towards the bottom, where the head of Kokopelli turns to the left.  The red and grey feathers from  the head of the kachina delicately extend out behind him into the snow.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Tim Nighswander/IMAGING4ART
